owner: Ojas (Product) — proposed by K27 (auto-churn), not signed off
source: CN 'Collection Orchestration Engine' PRD v3 §5.3 (named reusable cohorts, priority = list order, first match wins, orphan coverage) + CN 'Personal Loan 10-Day Post-Due Digital Collections Strategy' (C1-C5).
orphan_mode_note: DRAFT (PRD §5.3 WATCH OUT): UNASSIGNED is a LIVE orphan bucket, recomputed on every evaluation. A frozen snapshot cohort can still be made with snapshot_orphans() (kind 'snapshot', a fixed list of borrower ids) — it is labelled as a snapshot and never recomputes.
ids_note: Cohorts, journeys and overrides are keyed by the stable `id`, never by the display `name` (PRD §5.4 WATCH OUT: renaming must not orphan a journey).

cohorts.name: Opted out
cohorts.description: STOP / opt-out on any channel. No automated contact on any channel (K01 STOP_OPT_OUT).

cohorts.name: Paid / exited
cohorts.description: D7/LMS-verified payment cleared the obligation. A claim never lands here.

cohorts.name: Hardship (human only)
cohorts.description: Hardship reported (CM-03 intent, voicebot disposition or K13 hold). Automated outreach paused; L4 human.

cohorts.name: K13 hold (callback / supervisor)
cohorts.description: K13 callback pending or a routed stop (abusive / legal threat / fraud claim) until a supervisor clears it.

cohorts.name: Disputed
cohorts.description: Dispute raised. K13: ticket, outreach continues — DRAFT default: soft L1/L2 reminders only, no voice, no collection escalation.

cohorts.name: Payment claimed (unverified)
cohorts.description: Borrower says paid; waiting for D7/LMS verification (48 h pause, then verification follow-up).

cohorts.name: Engaged / promised
cohorts.description: Open promise-to-pay with a date: K01 PTP hold until the date, check payment on date + 1.

cohorts.name: Broken PTP
cohorts.description: A promise was broken in the last 10 days: PTP follow-up voicebot + WhatsApp.

cohorts.name: Unreachable on voice -> digital first
cohorts.description: 3+ unanswered calls in a row and no voice connect in 14 days: stop paying for voice, WhatsApp + SMS only.

cohorts.name: WhatsApp-responsive
cohorts.description: Replied on WhatsApp in the last 14 days (reads alone are reach, not a reply).

cohorts.name: Engaged (replied, no promise)
cohorts.description: Any meaningful reply in the last 7 days without an open promise: ask for a payment date.

cohorts.name: C5 High-ticket
cohorts.description: CN10: POS above the high-ticket threshold (portfolio p90 by default). Uses C4's calendar.

cohorts.name: C1 First-time bounce
cohorts.description: CN10: no prior bounce; stays C1 while the risk engine has not moved its tier off the C1 default.

cohorts.name: C4 High risk
cohorts.description: Risk tier HIGH or CRITICAL (CN10 C4 at Day 0: delinquency > 42 % or 3+ consecutive bounces).

cohorts.name: C3 Medium risk
cohorts.description: Risk tier MEDIUM (CN10 C3 at Day 0: delinquency 14-42 %).

cohorts.name: C2 Low risk
cohorts.description: Risk tier LOW (CN10 C2 at Day 0: delinquency 0-14 %).
